title: A relative dualizing complex is unique up to isomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that two relative dualizing complexes for a ring map are isomorphic (author lemma at source lines 5631-5635, label lemma-uniqueness-relative-dualizing). The proof (source lines 5637-5654) base changes both along the two coprojections of the tensor square, uses the evaluation-tensor identity twice to compare the resulting objects and restricts along a coprojection to conclude (proof lines 5637-5653). The two applications of the evaluation identity are the substance. H3.
